description: Team & Partners workspace: use my_inbox for durable assignments, submissions, and unread alerts; acknowledge_task when work starts; submit_task with a completion note and optional artifact URLs; and review_task to approve or request changes. Task assignments and submissions also send in-app notifications and email, while open Team pages receive live channel updates. MCP clients retrieve durable updates with my_inbox or my_tasks. Also supports tracked referral links (my_links), work logs (work_log), team channels (read_channel, post_channel — mention @sai for an AI answer, and optionally request an email alert), and owner-visible reports (report). Workers see authorised work and channels; the owner can assign_task by linked worker email.

artifact_urls.description: submit_task: public URLs for files, previews, documents, or other delivered work

assignee_email.description: assign_task (owner only): the worker account email

body.description: post_channel/report: the message or report details. In post_channel, include "@sai" to get an AI answer.

channel.description: read_channel/post_channel: channel name, default general (report posts to #bugs automatically)

decision.description: review_task (owner/reporter only): approve the submission or request changes

email_notify.description: post_channel: also email authorised channel recipients

image_url.description: report: public screenshot URL (host it with manage_media upload_file first, then pass the URL here)

note.description: acknowledge_task/submit_task/review_task/complete_task: a short status, handoff, or review note

page_url.description: report: the page where the problem happened

task_id.description: acknowledge_task/submit_task/review_task/complete_task: the task ID (from my_inbox or my_tasks)

worker_email.description: work_log (owner only): narrow to one worker

name: manage_team
